selection.rule: Chosen on the practice period only: best total per $1,000 among Strategy file as written, 30 days, 90 days, Outright options instead of spreads; if any has fewer than 5 practice trades, keep "Strategy file as written".

pass.text: Unseen period, "Strategy file as written": 8 trades (needs at least 8), total +1,308 per $1,000 (needs above 0), weekly buying with the same money -2,611 (must beat it). PASSED: it can be shown as a live idea.
pass.rule: At least 8 unseen-period trades, a total above 0 per $1,000, and better than buying SOL weekly with the same total money.
